## Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

Why would this be useful? What problem does it solve or what insight does it unlock?

## Category

<!-- Check all that apply -->
- [ ] New academic research factor
- [ ] New data source or data quality improvement
- [ ] Scoring / conviction model change
- [ ] Dashboard / UI feature
- [ ] GitHub Actions / CI/CD improvement
- [ ] Machine learning / data pipeline
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Proposed Implementation

If you have an idea of how this could be implemented, describe it here.

**For new research factors**, please cite the source paper:
> Author(s), "Title", Journal, Year. DOI or URL.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you've considered, and why you prefer the proposed approach.

## Additional Context

Any references, papers, screenshots, or other context that would help evaluate this request.
